body.summary: S003 gives the chat queue three protections. A dead window's lease is freed (a reloaded window re-homes the lease when its CLI survived and follows it until the CLI exits; the same window's lease is freed at once when the CLI is gone; another window's only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS, and never while it heartbeats). A message whose window is closed is marked not delivered after PRESENCE_GRACE_MS so the queue moves on, and dispose keeps the presence row so a reload never looks like a closed window. The bound is unchanged (ac5): enqueue is refused with FULL_NOTE at QUEUE_RECORD_BOUND; a resend replaces its own old row so it is never refused and loses nothing. HAND CHECK IS ONLY PARTIAL: only a single-window reload with a message queued behind a running turn was observed (queue file: new host pid holds the lease, no failed or not-delivered rows from the reload). The multi-window checks (reload mid-turn with the CLI alive, reload with a message waiting while a second window ticks, close a window with queued messages) are DEFERRED by the owner until a repo path bug that blocks multi-window use is fixed. Display half of ac3 is carried by S001 follow tests: turn-lifecycle.test.ts 'follow takes ownership from a dead host, reports every event, clears the cursor and calls onEnd' and 'a detached session-file turn is resumed by follow'; chat-panel.test.ts 'after a reload (a new host over the same store) a session with a live cursor is followed from the saved offset...' and "a second live window that is not the cursor's owner does not follow it; once the owner host is gone it takes over". Constraints: k1 holds (only the plugin's own SQLite queue is touched; no daemon store); k2 holds (10 min takeover needs the holder process gone and applies to another window's lease; the 500 bound is refused with a note, nothing dropped; no retry code here); k3 n/a (no UI change); k4 holds (store and worker stay free of the vscode module, injected deps); k5 holds (node:sqlite requirement unchanged). The three HLD amendments (sc1 markNotDeliveredIfHead; sc2 presenceOf plus takeOver holderGone and own-windowKey rule; HLD flush wording) were NOT filed: choosing 'file an amendment' at plan time only recorded the decision. They remain to be filed for the owner's approval.
